title: Stay away from sea lions and seals!
description:
Five languages, one message: Please stay away from sea lions and seals while visiting La Jolla. 🦭 

The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration advises maintaining a safe distance of at least 50 yards to avoid causing them stress or triggering aggressive defensive behavior.

If you have questions, please ask a ranger! 
#CityofSanDiego #SanDiego #LaJolla #Seal #SeaLion
